game.name: Brütal Legend (USA, Europe)(En,Fr,De,It)
game.desc: Brütal Legend on Xbox 360 is a beat'em all in which you play as a roadie named Eddie Riggs, a trashy rocker. Dive into a dreamlike world with omnipresent humour and a heavy metal atmosphere in the background. Armed with Separator, a two-bladed axe, and Clementine, his trusty guitar, get ready to take on Emperor Doviculus and his army of demons.
